title: Add Admin Menu Entries to Your Module | Orchard Core
description:
The admin menu of an Orchard Core site is built from the entries that modules provide, and a module that has pages of its own needs a way to put them there.

A class that implements INavigationProvider describes the menu items, a position decides where they appear, and AddNavigationProvider registers the class in the Startup of the module. The video builds a top-level item with two children, each opening its own page, and shows them in the admin.

In this video:
• What you will build: a root item with two children
• Pages to open: a controller with the Admin attribute, and two views
• The navigation provider: BuildNavigationAsync, Add and Action
• Position and order: numbers, PrefixPosition, start and end
• Register and run: AddNavigationProvider, then Tools, Features in the admin
• Beyond the example: AdminNavigationProvider, existing menus and permissions
